description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Valikaman North Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member - Declare that a member of the Vavuniya South Sinhala Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (A) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically declaring that members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
